whenToUse: More than about 10 options, or when typing helps: country, assignee, category, labels.
Server-backed search with paging (loadItems) and creatable values (onCreate).
avoidWhen: Fewer than 6 options — use Radio Group; 6–10 fixed options — use Select.
Linking database records with rich rows — use Record picker or User picker.
a11y: Wrap in Field so the trigger gets a label; the search box is named by searchPlaceholder.
Chips are removable with Backspace/Delete and announced; +N overflow is announced as N more selected.
